overview.Description: Aimei Health Technology Co., Ltd does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. It also intends to acquire small cap businesses in the biopharmaceutical, medical technology and device industries, as well as in the diagnostic and other service sectors. Aimei Health Technology Co., Ltd was incorporated in 2023 and is based in New York, New York.
